QuestInfo.name: Intro to Hideout Repair
QuestInfo.0: The #bPapyrus Brothers#k have a mission for you. Talk to them when you're ready.
QuestInfo.1: Your mission is to fix up the entrance to the hideout. Go to #b#m402000110##k and #b#m402000111##k and obtain #b#t4036140# x15#k by defeating #r#o2400300# monsters#k.
QuestInfo.2: You obtained the #t4036140#s and spoke with the Papyrus Brothers talked about repairing the hideout

0.msg: Word is you're unbeatable in a fight. But completing missions takes brains, just as much as brawns.

1.msg: Your first mission is to repair the hideout. A task suitable for a rookie.\r\n

2.msg: Don't act all high and mighty. Nobody here ever got a tough mission without proving they were ready first.\r\n

4.msg: What do you say? Think you're ready to repair the hideout?\r\n

0.msg: The spot that really needs the most TLC is the secret entrance. The iron there's all rusted.\r\n

1.msg: Repair the entrance with the #i4036140:#  #b#t4036140##k items commonly found in this area. #b15#k of them would probably be enough.\r\n

2.msg: The #r#o2400300#s#k in #b#m402000110##k and #b#m402000111##k have them. Come see us when you've gathered enough.\r\n

0.msg: Looks like you got all the materials. Let's have a look.\r\n
The iron around here isn't any good, but for lack of better materials, we've got no choice but to use it.\r\n

1.msg: Personally, I think the toxic air around here is responsible for corroding the metal.\r\n

0.msg: Repair the entrance with the #i4036140:#  #b#t4036140:##k items commonly found around here. #b15#k should be plenty. #r#o2400300#s#k items are carried by #b#m402000110##k and #b#m402000111##k monsters.\r\n
